name: @craftsmen/asyncapi-kafka-spring-template
description: AsyncAPI Generator template that produces the Spring Cloud Stream Kafka binder config, the publisher/consumer class and the Java record/enum models for one AsyncAPI operation.

scripts.test:order-service: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.output/order-service', { recursive: true, force: true })" && asyncapi generate fromTemplate ../order-service/src/main/resources/order-events-send.yaml . -o .output/order-service --param javaPackage=nl.craftsmen.asyncapidemo.orderservice.event --param messagingPackage=nl.craftsmen.asyncapidemo.orderservice.messaging --force-write
scripts.test:stock-service: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.output/stock-service', { recursive: true, force: true })" && asyncapi generate fromTemplate ../stock-service/src/main/resources/order-events-receive.yaml . -o .output/stock-service --param javaPackage=nl.craftsmen.asyncapidemo.stockservice.event --param messagingPackage=nl.craftsmen.asyncapidemo.stockservice.messaging --force-write
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run test:order-service && npm run test:stock-service

javaPackage.description: Java package for the generated record/enum models

messagingPackage.description: Java package for the generated publisher/consumer class
